tools.name: list_stacks
tools.description: Call this when the user names a library and you are not sure ProvenPin covers it, or after search_recipes returns nothing. Lists the libraries and frameworks that currently have passing, version-pinned recipes, with recipe counts; use the names as the stack filter in search_recipes.
